label: Shawl 0A
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: E-commerce product photo (474x474), head cropped: navy tuxedo jacket with a BLACK SATIN shawl lapel — one continuous rounded collar-to-lapel edge, no notch and no peak — single button at the waist, black bow tie, white shirt, white pocket square in a welt chest pocket. Shawl geometry is confirmed, but the satin band reads medium-to-wide relative to the chest, so the 'narrow, smaller sweep radius' 0A grade is NOT established; it could equally be a wider shawl grade.

Product photo (265x397) of a model in a navy DOUBLE-BREASTED suit; zooming the chest shows a self-faced SHAWL lapel — one continuous rounded edge from the neck down to the front, no notch and no peak — with a 4-button double-breasted front (two rows of two), light blue shirt, patterned tie and pocket square. The shawl band is comparatively narrow with a tight sweep radius, which is consistent with a narrow shawl, but width grade cannot be measured from a posed photo.
